headline: US Midterm Elections Deliver Congressional Majority to Democrats
summary: The 2026 US midterm elections dealt a major blow to Donald Trump and the Republican Party as opposition Democrats won control of both chambers of Congress.
why: Shifts in congressional control directly influence federal fiscal policy, regulatory appointments, and legislative agendas, creating major ripples across US financial markets.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: Changes in legislative control alter the trajectory of US fiscal policy and executive branch oversight.
